design: Independent stage on 32 topic-disjoint human-written development questions in DiffQG. No use of the supplied target answer span, focused sentence, seed question or [SEP] location in serving. Search all strictly forward paired contexts using old/current BM25 plus current Contriever. Same six passages for direct and revision-aware readers. Adapted open QA, not original DiffQG question-generation performance. All methods receive the same requested snapshot year. Search the entire forward bank and select the six best entries from that year for the primary analysis. Record the six all-years results separately.
hypothesis: When several facts change in a paragraph, a relevant edit should support an answer in two surrounding texts: the new paragraph and the old paragraph with that single edit applied. Reverting the edit in the new paragraph should withdraw support. This local comparison might distinguish a factual update from incidental rewritten text better than comparing the two whole editions.
pilot: Teacher-free extractive screen. Enumerate target spans of at most 24 tokens and their current answer-vs-null logit margin (RoBERTa-SQuAD2). Merge edit blocks separated by <=2 lexical tokens. Keep at most two regions per passage ranked by their strongest overlapping target span. Form four source worlds per region: base, target, target with that edit reverted, base with that edit added. Score a candidate surface as its best span-vs-null margin in a world, using a finite floor of -10 for absent surfaces. Compare direct current, overlapping-span heuristic, whole-edition contrast, single rollback, and symmetric rollback/addback. Use 0.5 times stability correction, clamp contrast terms to +/-6, and charge source rank log(1+zero-based rank). Surface proposals are the current winner and up to four distinct best overlapping spans per region. An open generative comparator and simple time-aware text reader on the same full candidate set precede any promotion.
higher_budget: If evidence supports revision-specific reading, compare against model-generated current answers and contextual whole-edition contrast. Discard a surface-only hypothesis if even the oracle among all its proposals cannot pass the gate. An extractive gain alone cannot establish a novel native-memory contribution. Any 9B final comparison must use actual unconstrained answers and a strong matched reader.
metrics: Exact match and token F1 against the reference noun phrase. Distinguish source localization, surface proposal coverage and current-answer correctness. No gold-source hints. One query per topic; 96 reserved topics unopened.
limits: Model-free data prep during HoH batch; do not begin a competing method run until that batch finishes. One 20-minute CPU screen and one 30-minute Qwen comparator phase; one implementation repair; no paid credits.
